text:
lucas ng: FYI Arm reached out asking for a short preview program. They want to validate embeddings+generation perf on Neoverse N2 and discuss a possible joint cloud marketplace listing if results look good. They mentioned needing an NDA and a one-page EAP intake.
priya ramesh: Nice. Marketplace listing will need product + legal + marketplace ops alignment. Do we have a playbook for co-listings? @marketing should we prepare a draft listing copy but mark it embargoed? :eyes: 
tom harrison: From perf side we need explicit workload samples. Ask partner for: model sizes (they mentioned 7B/13B), payload sizes, batch shapes, and any nonstandard optimizations they expect (e.g., microcode-enabled matmul). Also confirm whether they want end-to-end API latency or kernel-only numbers.
alina kovács: Infra question: will they provide boards/instances or do we run on Redwood Dedicated sim nodes? If partner provides boards we need isolated network + ephemeral creds. If we simulate, we should call out expected delta in the 1-pager.
partner-bot: Created CRM EAP ticket: EAP-NEOVERSE-2026-02. Link: https://redwood.internal/eap/EAP-NEOVERSE-2026-02 
lucas ng: Good notes. I'll ask them to sign the NDA first. We should also propose a benchmark CSV schema so results are comparable across partners and we can ingest into perfboard. Schema idea: timestamp, model, quant, device, batch, seq_len, p50, p95, tokens_per_sec, notes. Thoughts?
tom harrison: That schema works. Add a column for "kv_cache_warm" boolean and "seed" for determinism. Also request raw traces for first 128 tokens for KV analysis.
priya ramesh: For the marketplace angle: we need to confirm partner's logo usage rights, joint messaging, and whether the partner requires a co-announcement. If co-announcement expected, marketing will need 3 weeks lead time for assets + legal sign-off on quotes.
alina kovács: Quick run snippet for initial smoke (we'll containerize later):
```
./rw-bench --model redwood/7b-embed --device neoverse-n2 --quant-8 --batch 8 --seq 256 --kv-cache false --out csv
```
Include a note to toggle --power-telemetry if partner provides telemetry socket.
lucas ng: Action items: 1) Me -> request NDA template + workload samples; 2) Priya -> coordinate with marketing for embargoed listing copy; 3) Tom -> perf schema + CI job; 4) Alina -> infra runbook + isolation checklist. Target: have NDA signed in 72h, runbook + perf CI in 7 business days.
partner-bot: Partner requested an EAP kickoff calendar invite and a short agenda: objectives, data & access, benchmarks, success criteria, comms plan. Suggested timeframe: week of Apr 14.
priya ramesh: Marketing asks that we avoid any mention of pricing in initial listing drafts. Also capture whether partner wants marketplace SKU (managed) vs. reference architecture (bring-your-own).
tom harrison: If they want BYO board testing we should ask for kernel version, firmware, and any custom compiler flags. Those can affect perf significantly.
alina kovács: I'll prepare the isolation checklist: VPC subnet, restricted egress, ephemeral keys, logging retention. Also put together a minimal perf runbook: preflight checks, known-good container image, smoke commands, rollback steps.
lucas ng: I'll draft the 1-pager and include the perf schema + runbook link. Will ping legal for the NDA and loop in partner contact. If marketing wants to preview listing copy before NDA we can share a redacted stub. :rocket:
priya ramesh: Great. Please add a short slide for exec visibility: why this matters (marketplace uplift + hardware partner validation) and which KPIs we'll track (p50 latency, embeddings throughput, qualitative parity).
partner-bot: Reminder: use template https://redwood.internal/templates/eap-intake.md for the one-pager.
lucas ng: Thanks all. I'll post the draft 1-pager here when ready and set up the kickoff invite.
priya ramesh: :thumbsup:
